Name: Asters Bathroom Replaces Spouseroom (with bachelor mode)
Author: Asterisk555
TagLine: Several bathroom designs that replace the spouseroom and can also be added to the starter farmhouse (now with bachelor mode)
Description:
Several bathroom designs that replace the spouseroom
If you __don't__ want to replace the spouseroom see [Asters Bathroom Extension](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12404)  instead

Optional config that lets you have a bathroom and kitchen in the starter farmhouse
now with bachelor mode (aka "I can be single and still have a bathroom" mode)

I do art commissions! Message me on nexus, discord, or see https://ko-fi.com/asteriskart. You can also follow me on [twitter](https://twitter.com/AsteriskArt555)

_Quick start:_

*   For the Content Patcher version you need version   1.19 of CP  or higher

*   Extract this mod and it's required mods into your mods folder (if you are confused check out [this guide](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started)  )

*   Choose which design you want in the config.json (there is a visual guide in the mod folder)

*   it's ready to play!

_Config guide:_

   **Keep the frogs:**

*   Available options: true, false

*   Lets you keep frogs in your bathroom if someone offers them to you
**Manual Spouseroom Selection:**

*   Available options: Abigail, Alex, Elliott, Emily, Haley, Harvey, Leah, Maru, Penny, Sam, Sebastian, Shane, Krobus

*   For multiple spouse compatibility, choose which person's room you want to replace with the bathroom
   **Decoration Style:** Choose bathroom design

*   Available options: 1,2,3,4,7,8,9,10,11,12,13,14

*   See the "Decoration Style guide" folder inside the mod for pictures
   **Bachelor pad mode:**

*   Available options: true, false

*   Lets you have the bathroom in the starter farmhouse

*   Let's you have the bathroom even when you're not living with someone

*   Can be used even if you still plan on marrying someone later

*   Use with [No built in kitchen](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12120) if you want the bathroom but not the kitchen in the starter farmhouse

_Compatibility:_
**Modded farmhouses**

*   Should be compatible with the spouse room replacement

*   Most modded farmhouses will have compatibility issues with bachelor mode and the starter farmhouse bathroom (so switch these off in the config)
**Multiple spouses**

*   General compatibility with recolours, interior recolours, and with kitchen and general farmhouse tile sheet retextures because this mod has its own just for the bathroom only
**Android**

*   Not compatible
**Mods with built-in compatibility**

*   [No built in kitchen](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12120)
_Matching Furniture Mods:_

*   [Vanilla Spouse Furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12187) if you still want the spouse room furniture that got removed

*   The Statue used in the fountain is by Wabi, and is from [Ornamental Garden Furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11555)

*   [Adorable Cottage Bathroom Furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10982)

*   Japanese Furniture Mod (in development)

*   [PortaPool](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12137), for if you just want to build your own bath in-game

_To uninstall:_

*   Just remove the mod; Depending on your config some items may end up in the void, but they shouldn't be hard to retrieve using [NoClip](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900).

_For mod authors:_

*   For built in compatibility for modded farmhouses see [Asters Bathroom Extension](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12404)

*   This mod loads it's tilesheets so you can also make [CP] recolours for it

*   I can try making compat with custom NPCs if the author requests it, my guess is you'll either need to have loaded your SpouseRoom using CP or have a "hasmod" condition that switches off the spouseroom when a user has this mod. Or give permission for users to replace the spouseroom.TMX in your mod with one from this mod, with the tilesheets of course.
_Art Credits:_

*   The painting in the galaxy themed bathroom is by [AuraTheFox](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/108217533)

*   The Statue used in the fountain is by Wabi, and is from [Ornamental Garden Furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11555)
